I'm here, Eric.

Nothing new from me on the NerdQX since we last spoke, it's still with the team and tagged as a missing unit. They're on until 6pm Eastern today.

Is it the NerdQX you're chasing again, or something else I can pull up?
I need a number to call. Apparently there ignoring you

There's no phone line, Eric. This chat is the direct route to Abel and Georges, and it's already open with your order on it.

I've pushed it up again as a person request on Shop···· and the missing NerdQX. They're on until 6pm Eastern today, so keep this window open and one of them picks it up here. If you step away, it goes to (email hidden)
Handed to the team · Customer asking for a phone number, says he is being ignored after multiple chat
It's in front of them now. Stay in this window if you can.
You keep saying this but they don’t respond.

I hear you, and I'm not going to keep repeating myself.

Here's what's new on my side: I checked the warehouse record, and there is no second parcel for the NerdQX. Only the Octaxe box was ever built. So this is a re-ship, not a lost package, and that's what's sitting with Abel and Georges now.

I can't book the re-ship myself and I won't invent a date for it. They're on until 6pm Eastern. Everything here also goes to your email.
